basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old gamer from Barcelona, Spain, who recently got into Reddit to engage more with the gaming community. I work as a graphic designer, and in my downtime, I love playing online games like Paladins and Call of Duty Mobile. I'm not super competitive, but I enjoy unlocking rare skins and achievements. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. My interests include fantasy games, art, and collecting game memorabilia.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in graphic design, learned through a combination of formal education and online courses. My gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and interacting with other gamers online, as well as from following gaming news and communities.
